page: Microsoft Azure L80s_v4 is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by a dedicated 40-core, 80-thread Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and matrix acceleration instructions, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (amx_tile, amx_int8), alongside hardware cryptographic extensions. The hardware configuration bundles 640 GB of system memory and 19,200 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage, providing substantial local capacity without requiring external storage attachments. There are no discrete GPUs included in this configuration.

Benchmark testing demonstrates high compute and data processing capabilities across multi-threaded scenarios. In multi-core CPU evaluations, the server achieves top-tier scores in Geekbench multi-core (21,672.0) and Geekbench image processing (21,642.0), alongside strong results in stress-ng multi-core processing (69,325.3) and PassMark CPU testing (79,652.77). Memory subsystem throughput remains consistent under heavy load, achieving 223.47 GB/sec in large-block read bandwidth and 94.58 GB/sec in write bandwidth. High input/output efficiency is reflected in database and cache workloads, with Redis SET operations reaching 91.92 million operations per second and static web throughput exceeding 105 GB/sec.

The dense integration of 80 vCPUs, 640 GB of memory, and 19.2 TB of NVMe SSD storage offers favorable resource density for high-throughput, latency-sensitive applications. Cost efficiency is maximized when workloads fully saturate the integrated NVMe storage tier, bypassing the bandwidth limitations and transaction expenses associated with network-attached block storage. The system is well configured for large-scale transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, real-time in-memory data processing, search indexing, and extensive compilation pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure L80s_v4 is a storage-optimized server running on an x86_64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor delivering 80 vCPUs (40 physical cores) clocked at 4.2 GHz with 260 MB of L3 cache. The platform is configured with 640 GB of RAM and 19,200 GB of integrated high-speed NVMe SSD storage, operating without dedicated GPU accelerators. Benchmark results indicate exceptional throughput across parallel tasks, including top-tier Geekbench multi-core performance (21,672.0) and over 105 GB/sec static web throughput. Memory bandwidth exceeds 223 GB/sec on uncached reads, while key-value metrics reach 91.92 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware-level acceleration features such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX augment matrix and mathematical computation. This virtual machine configuration provides high density and performance efficiency for I/O-intensive workloads, distributed databases, large-scale Redis deployments, data warehousing, and extensive software compilation tasks.
